description:
Connection to one Stalwart server (v0.16), owned by a namespace: its
token is that namespace's, and only its objects use it unless
`sharedWith` says otherwise. What an operator limited to one namespace
uses. Objects bound to it are not governed by `StalwartNamespacePolicy`
(the namespace's own token bounds them) and write their secrets as
Kubernetes `Secret`s only: the operator's Vault identity is shared by
every namespace. `Ready` tells whether the server answers with the
token below and speaks a supported management schema.

appPasswordTokenSecretRef.description:
A second API key of Stalwart, on the same account as the one above,
in a `Secret` of this namespace with the same label: the one that
creates, rotates and revokes the App Passwords of the
`StalwartServiceAccount`s (permissions `authenticate`,
`impersonate`, `emailSend` and `sysAppPassword*` only). Read on
every reconcile of a `StalwartServiceAccount`; unset, those fail
with `TokenSecretMissing` (the other kinds don't use it).

sharedWith.description:
Other namespaces (or cluster-scoped objects) allowed to use this
instance — and its token. Unset: this namespace only.

clusterScoped.description: Cluster-scoped objects may use this instance.

namespaceSelector.description:
Namespaces whose labels match this selector may use this instance.
An empty selector (`{}`) matches every namespace: the instance —
and the token it holds — is then shared with the whole cluster.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description: A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values. Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description: values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn, the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist, the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic merge patch.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

namespaces.description: Namespaces whose objects may use this instance.

submission.description: The submission service the emitted credentials announce.

host.description: Host name of the submission service.

security.description: Transport security a client must use.

tls.description:
TLS verification of the connection above; the CA `Secret` lives in
this namespace.

caSecretRef.description:
Optional custom CA certificate (a PEM bundle under `key`) to verify
the instance's TLS with, read from a `Secret` of the instance's own
namespace. Added on top of the platform trust store.

insecureSkipVerify.description:
Skip certificate verification entirely — insecure, intended only for
throwaway/self-signed instances. Prefer `caSecretRef` below.

tokenSecretRef.description:
An API key of Stalwart (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`), in a
`Secret` of this namespace labelled
`stalwart.weebo.io/instance-token: "true"` (without the label the
operator doesn't read it). Read on every reconcile: rotating it
needs no restart.

url.description:
Base URL of the Stalwart HTTP listener, e.g.
`http://stalwart.mail.svc:8080` (JMAP at `<url>/jmap`).
